In brief: This week will be characterized by warm temperatures and high precipitation chances, with rain likely on most days, particularly in the late afternoon and evening hours. The current conditions in Abuja are marked by a temperature of 22°C, which feels like 25°C due to the high humidity of 94%. The wind is calm, blowing at a speed of 3 km/h, and the UV index is 0, indicating no significant ultraviolet radiation. The traffic on Nnamdi Azikiwe Expressway is light, with a speed of 39 km/h, similar to the free-flow speed, indicating no major congestion. As we look ahead to the week, a low-pressure system is expected to develop over the region, bringing with it increased moisture and instability in the atmosphere.
### Monday The low-pressure system will start to take hold, leading to an increase in cloud cover and precipitation chances. The high temperature will reach 29°C, while the low will dip to 22°C, with a 41% chance of rain. The rain is likely to be most intense in the late afternoon and evening hours, with the possibility of thunderstorms in some areas. The humidity will remain high, ranging from 80% to 90% throughout the day. In areas such as Maitama and Garki, the rain may lead to increased traffic congestion, particularly during the evening commute. The wind direction will shift from northwest to southwest, leading to an increase in moisture advection from the Gulf of Guinea. This will contribute to the high precipitation chances and potentially lead to flash flooding in low-lying areas such as Wuse and Gwarinpa. The rainfall accumulation is expected to range from 10 to 20 mm, with some areas potentially receiving more than 30 mm. The temperature will feel warmer than the actual reading, due to the high humidity, particularly in areas with dense vegetation such as Aso Rock. The models suggest that the low-pressure system will continue to intensify, leading to an increase in precipitation chances and potential thunderstorms. My best guess is that the rain will be most intense between 4 pm and 7 pm, with a chance of scattered showers throughout the night. The cloud cover will be extensive, leading to a reduction in ultraviolet radiation, with the UV index expected to remain low throughout the day.
